title: Prettier gate failed on release-notes scratch files committed by mistake
summary: The Format (Prettier) job failed because two temporary release-notes files, notes.md and release-notes.md, were committed to the repository root. They were not Prettier-formatted. All other CI jobs passed.
recommendation: Write temporary release-notes files outside the repository, or check git status before committing, so they are not committed. Remove such files rather than formatting them.
evidence: Format (Prettier)	Check Markdown, YAML, and JSON formatting	2026-11-01T17:31:40.8905916Z [warn] notes.md
Format (Prettier)	Check Markdown, YAML, and JSON formatting	2026-11-01T17:31:40.9915832Z [warn] release-notes.md
Format (Prettier)	Check Markdown, YAML, and JSON formatting	2026-11-01T17:31:41.0204453Z [warn] Code style issues found in 2 files. Run Prettier with --write to fix.
root_cause: Commit fc57e37 included notes.md and release-notes.md, temporary copies of the v0.2.0 CHANGELOG section written while editing the GitHub release notes. They were not Prettier-formatted, and Prettier checks every Markdown file in the repository.

fix.description: Commit 02eb6eb deleted notes.md and release-notes.md. Nothing else referenced them.
fix.validation_evidence: Checked GitHub Actions run 41332624646 after fix commit 02eb6eb: Format (Prettier) passed. Compared with failing run 41331905922.

title: Test failed on GitHub Actions because Rich colored the CLI usage error
summary: test_runs_reports_errors_and_validates_the_limit asserted '--limit' in the usage error output; on GitHub Actions Rich added ANSI color codes, so the assertion failed (1 test failed).
recommendation: Assert on CLI output with ANSI color codes removed, or with color disabled, so tests do not depend on the terminal.
evidence: Tests (Python 3.12)	Run pytest with coverage	2026-11-01T13:40:09.4198290Z tests/test_investigate.py:907: AssertionError
Tests (Python 3.12)	Run pytest with coverage	2026-11-01T13:40:09.4209335Z FAILED tests/test_investigate.py::test_runs_reports_errors_and_validates_the_limit
root_cause: On GitHub Actions, Rich colored the Typer usage error and split '--limit' into separately styled dashes, so the plain substring assertion at tests/test_investigate.py:907 did not match.

fix.description: Commit 60731a9 removed ANSI color codes before the assertion and checked for "Invalid value for '--limit'".
fix.validation_evidence: Run 41312342881 failed test_runs_reports_errors_and_validates_the_limit at c4b5de5. Locally the test fails at c4b5de5 only with GITHUB_ACTIONS=true and passes at fix 60731a9 with and without it. Tests (Python 3.12) passed in run 41312876040 at 60731a9.

title: New CI quality gate failed on pre-existing formatting, typing, and Bandit findings
summary: The first run of the CI quality gate failed four jobs: Prettier found 3 unformatted files, Ruff format found 12 files to reformat, mypy found 9 type errors, and Bandit reported B310 for urlopen without a URL scheme restriction.
recommendation: Bring the existing code into compliance in the same change that enables a new check: format with Prettier and Ruff, fix the reported mypy errors, and restrict urlopen to http(s) URLs before suppressing B310.
evidence: Format (Prettier)	Check Markdown, YAML, and JSON formatting	2026-10-23T16:42:11.1942883Z [warn] Code style issues found in 3 files. Run Prettier with --write to fix.
Lint (Ruff)	Ruff format check	2026-10-23T16:42:10.9226749Z 12 files would be reformatted, 22 files already formatted
Security (Bandit)	Run Bandit	2026-10-23T16:42:13.8758687Z >> Issue: [B310:blacklist] Audit url open for permitted schemes. Allowing use of file:/ or custom schemes is often unexpected.
Type check (mypy)	Run mypy	2026-10-23T16:42:24.2208760Z Found 9 errors in 6 files (checked 17 source files)
root_cause: Commit 43c1910 added Prettier, Ruff format, mypy, and Bandit gates without bringing the existing code into compliance: 3 files were not Prettier-formatted, 12 files were not Ruff-formatted, 6 files had 9 mypy errors, and 3 urlopen calls accepted any URL scheme (Bandit B310).

fix.description: Commit 98e39ea formatted the files with Prettier 3.9.9 and Ruff 0.16.10, fixed the 9 mypy errors, and restricted the Ollama URLs to http(s) before the urlopen calls (with a justified nosec B310).
fix.validation_evidence: Manually checked GitHub Actions run 39991021644 after fix commit 98e39ea. Prettier, Ruff, Bandit, and mypy all passed. Compared with failing run 39988949831.

title: Ruff lint failed on an unsorted import block in a new test file
summary: Ruff reported I001 (import block is un-sorted or un-formatted) in tests/test_performance.py, so the lint job failed with 'Found 1 error.'
recommendation: Run 'ruff check --fix' (or sort the imports) before committing new modules.
evidence: quality	UNKNOWN STEP	2026-10-22T21:42:47.1656296Z I001 [*] Import block is un-sorted or un-formatted
quality	UNKNOWN STEP	2026-10-22T21:42:47.1659815Z  --> tests/test_performance.py:1:1
quality	UNKNOWN STEP	2026-10-22T21:42:47.1669998Z Found 1 error.
root_cause: Commit 351979c added tests/test_performance.py with its 'from circa.performance' and 'from circa.pipeline' imports above the other circa imports, which Ruff's import-sorting rule I001 rejects.

fix.description: Commit bee8ff2 sorted the imports in tests/test_performance.py.
fix.validation_evidence: Run 39859422492 failed with Ruff I001 in tests/test_performance.py at 351979c. Fix bee8ff2 sorted the imports; ruff check --select I reproduces I001 on 351979c's file and passes on bee8ff2's. Job 'quality' passed in run 39980112618 at bee8ff2.

title: zizmor rejected a pinned GitHub Action with a known vulnerability
summary: The workflow audit (zizmor, online mode) reported GHSA-5xjx-3w67-w9x9 for pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish v1.14.2 at publish.yml lines 86 and 106.
recommendation: Update the pinned action to the patched release (by commit SHA) and run zizmor online locally before pushing workflow changes.
evidence: Workflows (actionlint + zizmor)	Run zizmor	2026-11-01T20:16:34.4483985Z ##[error]publish.yml:86: action has a known vulnerability: GHSA-5xjx-3w67-w9x9
Workflows (actionlint + zizmor)	Run zizmor	2026-11-01T20:16:34.4493662Z ##[error]publish.yml:106: action has a known vulnerability: GHSA-5xjx-3w67-w9x9
root_cause: Commit e651c26 added .github/workflows/publish.yml pinned to pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish v1.14.2, which is affected by the critical advisory GHSA-5xjx-3w67-w9x9 (fixed in v1.14.3); the local zizmor run was offline and did not check advisories.

fix.description: Commit b086262 pinned pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish to v1.14.3 (7245906fb61fa33a13554f9d5fb856fe61758086).
fix.validation_evidence: Run 41345998382 failed zizmor on GHSA-5xjx-3w67-w9x9 for pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish v1.14.2 at e651c26. Fix b086262 changes only that pin, to v1.14.3. Workflows (actionlint + zizmor) passed in run 41346114303 at b086262.

title: Blaze prefill tests failed at collection on an import of a helper that was never added
summary: Nightly Blaze Models Prefill tests failed to collect test_prefill_transformer_chunked.py: ImportError for sparse_mla_overlap_gather_rows from models.demos.deepseek_v3_d_p.tt.tt_ccl. Seven test legs failed this way in run 40452853696.

environment.job: Galaxy-Blaze-models-prefill / (GLM-5.3-744B) chunked prefill accuracy code_debug 55k@5k + padded 15k@5k, no-trace and traced [bh_sc1]

recommendation: When two changes touch the same module, re-run test collection (pytest --collect-only) on the merged result; import the helper that the module actually defines.
evidence: [1,0]<stdout>:     from models.demos.deepseek_v3_d_p.tt.tt_ccl import per_axis_topology, sparse_mla_overlap_gather_rows

[1,0]<stdout>: E   ImportError: cannot import name 'sparse_mla_overlap_gather_rows' from 'models.demos.deepseek_v3_d_p.tt.tt_ccl' (/home/runner/_work/tt-metal/tt-metal/models/demos/deepseek_v3_d_p/tt/tt_ccl.py)
[1,0]<stdout>: ERROR models/demos/deepseek_v3_d_p/tests/test_prefill_transformer_chunked.py
root_cause: PR #62411 changed test_prefill_transformer_chunked.py to import sparse_mla_overlap_gather_rows from tt_ccl, but PR #62477, merged about two hours earlier, kept the constant _SPARSE_MLA_OVERLAP_GATHER_ROWS = 1 and never added the function; at commit c7b41d5c7 tt_ccl.py defines only the constant, so test collection failed with ImportError.

fix.description: Commit c30746f89 (PR #62673) made the test use _SPARSE_MLA_OVERLAP_GATHER_ROWS again. The first nightly run that included it (40635507280, head 1768d2e38) passed this job.
fix.validation_evidence: Run 40452853696 (c7b41d5c7) failed collection with ImportError for sparse_mla_overlap_gather_rows; at c7b41d5c7 tt_ccl.py defines only _SPARSE_MLA_OVERLAP_GATHER_ROWS. Fix c30746f89 (PR #62673, which cites the run) imports the constant. The same GLM chunked accuracy job passed in nightly run 40635507280, whose head includes the fix.

title: GitHub Actions release failed updating a protected Git tag
summary: The tt-metal release workflow failed because GitHub rejected an operation on a protected Git ref. The exact tag and SHA conflict remain unconfirmed.
recommendation: Inspect the full job log and identify the actual tag and commit SHAs. Do not automatically force-move a protected release tag. If a tag points to a different commit, stop with a clear diagnostic and determine whether a new version tag is appropriate.
evidence: HttpError: Repository rule violations found
Cannot update this protected ref.
root_cause: Unconfirmed hypothesis: the release workflow may have attempted to update an existing protected Git tag to a different commit.

fix.description: Detect a tag-to-SHA mismatch and stop the release instead of automatically moving a protected tag.

title: macOS CPU smoke test crashed: CPU slot-mapping override kept parameters the Triton kernel had dropped
summary: The vLLM server in the macOS Apple Silicon smoke test died on its first request: the CPU replacement for the compute-slot-mapping Triton kernel raised 'RuntimeError: Boolean value of Tensor with more than one value is ambiguous' at an assert in vllm/utils/cpu_triton_utils.py. Nightly runs failed the same way from 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-17.
keywords: Boolean value of Tensor with more than one value is ambiguous
recommendation: Keep CPU kernel overrides' parameter lists identical to the Triton kernel they replace (the dispatcher passes arguments by position in the kernel's order), and test the override's argument forwarding when the kernel signature changes.
evidence: File "/Users/runner/work/vllm/vllm/vllm/utils/cpu_triton_utils.py", line 31, in _compute_slot_mapping_kernel_impl
assert block_size * BLOCKS_PER_KV_BLOCK == KV_CACHE_BLOCK_SIZE
RuntimeError: Boolean value of Tensor with more than one value is ambiguous
root_cause: Commit 02e55d2af (PR #57169) removed the block_size and BLOCKS_PER_KV_BLOCK parameters from the compute-slot-mapping Triton kernel, but the CPU override _compute_slot_mapping_kernel_impl in vllm/utils/cpu_triton_utils.py kept them. The Triton dispatcher passes arguments positionally in the kernel's order, so later arguments shifted into the wrong parameters and a tensor reached 'assert block_size * BLOCKS_PER_KV_BLOCK == KV_CACHE_BLOCK_SIZE', raising the ambiguous-truth RuntimeError.

fix.description: Commit 556ac15eb (PR #61992) removed block_size and BLOCKS_PER_KV_BLOCK from the CPU override and added a test that it forwards the kernel's arguments. The next nightly run (39090807113, head 03ee2e134, which includes the fix) passed the macos-15 job, and every nightly through 2026-11-01 passed.
fix.validation_evidence: Run 38672199773 (429a3da66) failed with RuntimeError at the assert in cpu_triton_utils._compute_slot_mapping_kernel_impl; 02e55d2af had removed block_size and BLOCKS_PER_KV_BLOCK from the Triton kernel but not from the CPU override. Fix 556ac15eb (PR #61992) removes them and adds a forwarding test. Nightlies 38018347916 and 38995700592 show the same error; the macos-15 job passed in 39090807113, whose head includes the fix, and in every nightly through 2026-11-01.
